view: Frontal (PA) chest radiograph, upright, L marker at image upper right (conventional orientation)
technical_quality: Adequate: inspiration to ~9 posterior ribs, minimal rotation (clavicles roughly symmetric about the spinous processes), penetration adequate with vertebral bodies visible behind the heart, costophrenic angles and apices included; scapulae only partly rotated off the lateral upper lung fields; mild rightward deviation of the trachea at the arch level attributable to aortic unfolding rather than rotation.

abnormalities.finding: Coarse, increased reticular/bronchovascular markings with mild hazy patchy opacity in the perihilar to medial basal region, suspicious for interstitial infiltrate or bronchitic change; no dense lobar consolidation or air bronchogram
Mildly accentuated bronchovascular/interstitial markings (less marked than the right side), including retrocardiac region
Prominent hila bilaterally, more likely vascular/age-related than adenopathy
Unfolded, tortuous thoracic aorta with prominent aortic knob (age-related); heart size normal (CTR ~0.35)
Degenerative changes (spondylosis) of the thoracic spine; no rib fracture or lytic lesion seen
Gastric fundal air bubble under the left hemidiaphragm (normal); costophrenic angles sharp, no pleural effusion or pneumothorax

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（右上方可見 L 側標記），吸氣度尚可、無明顯旋轉、穿透度適當，雙側肩胛骨部分重疊於上肺野外側。右下肺野自肺門周圍至內側基底部可見支氣管血管紋理增粗、網狀變化並伴輕度模糊浸潤影，左下肺野紋理亦略增加（右側較明顯）；雙側肺門略顯突出，較可能為血管性或老年性變化。心臟大小正常，胸主動脈迂曲、主動脈弓突出（老年性變化），氣管大致居中；雙側肋膈角銳利，無胸水或氣胸；胸椎退化性變化。雙側上腹部投影處可見兩條弧形外部高密度偽影（疑為衣物、屏蔽物或擺位裝置），無胸管、引流管或其他體內裝置。
